verdict.rationale: Unreal's delegate system explicitly supports binding functions to be called automatically at a future time/event (unreal-docs-3, unreal-docs-20), and Blueprints visual scripting gives designers programmer-level control to construct such logic (unreal-docs-1), while Python editor scripting and Remote Control's HTTP/WebSocket API let external systems trigger engine actions on events (unreal-docs-22–25, unreal-docs-28-29). However none of the docs explicitly describe an 'event graph' or rule/trigger authoring workflow by name, and there's no independent corroboration of building automated event-rule systems. Missing for 10: explicit Blueprint Event Graph/trigger documentation, hands-on or community validation of event-driven rule automation.
